name: mcp-hyperspace-memory

tools.name: memory_remember
tools.description: Store a new memory, event, or fact for the agent. Automatically vectorizes text and saves to collection 'agent_cognitive_memories_129' with session_id and tags in metadata. Returns a memory_id you can use to update or delete it later.

session_id.description: Session or conversation identifier. Used to scope recall to a specific session.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Retrieve the most relevant memories for a query. Searches the agent's memory collection 'agent_cognitive_memories_129' using semantic similarity. Optionally filter by session_id to stay within a conversation context.

query.description: What to search for in memory.

session_id.description: Optional: filter results to a specific session.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete a specific memory by its ID from collection 'agent_cognitive_memories_129'. Use the memory_id returned by memory_remember or memory_recall.

tools.name: memory_update
tools.description: Update an existing memory by deleting it and storing a new version. The new memory_id may differ from the original.

memory_id.description: ID of the memory to replace.

session_id.description: Session identifier (keep the same as the original if updating in place).

tags.description: Updated tags for the new memory.

tools.name: memory_list_sessions
tools.description: List unique session_ids present in the memory collection 'agent_cognitive_memories_129'. Useful to understand which conversations have stored memories.

limit.description: Max number of recent memories to scan for session IDs (default: 100).

tools.name: memory_explore_hierarchy
tools.description: Explore conceptual hierarchy in the agent's memory using Lorentz Cone Subsumption. Navigate 'up' to find parent/broader concepts or 'down' to find more specific sub-concepts.

concept_id.description: The memory/concept ID to start from.

direction.description: 'up' → broader parent concepts. 'down' → specific descendant concepts.

tools.name: memory_consolidate
tools.description: Consolidate a cluster of related memories into a single abstract concept using the Fréchet Mean on the hyperboloid. Helps compress repetitive episodic memories into semantic knowledge.

topic_query.description: A topic or query to identify the cluster of memories to consolidate.

tools.name: memory_verify_claim
tools.description: Verify whether a logical claim is geometrically consistent with stored memories. Computes Lorentz + Cosine hybrid distance between premise and conclusion in 129D MRL space. Returns VERIFIED or REJECTED with a trust_score (0–1). Use this to prevent hallucinations.

conclusion.description: The claim to verify against the premise.
